text: What can you obtain from Business Chinese Course The training aims to help international students conquer obstacles in listening and speaking Business Chinese through word and sentence expanding, case discussion etc., to introduce you business culture and etiquette knowledge, to strengthen your Chinese communication ability in business environment. Who need to attend oral business Chinese course Those who want to improve the applicants’ ability of business Chinese and those who would like to work relevant to Chinese businessTwo topicsOral Business Chinese: Professional textbooks combining Chinese language, job-hunting ability and profession business attainment To improve individual profession quality by case study, class activity and after-class practice. Basic skill of hunting job: Business Chinese Test, CV preparation, Cover letter, Interview written exam. Classes and Application Qualification Classes Mastered Glossary Finished Chinese class hours Preliminary 1200 300 class hours Intermediate 2500 600 class hours Advanced 5000 Above 900 class hours Period of Study 1 semester or 2 semesters (1 year);
